{{Top}}
'''Polarity sinks''' were standard pieces of equipment installed on several models of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. They were present on [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]], [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3]], [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4]] and [[R5-series astromech droid]]s.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
